76  def ping_dxl_tool(self):
77  try:
78  resp = self.__service_ping_dxl_tool()
79  if (resp is not None):
80  return resp.state, resp.tool.id
81  else:
82  return CommandStatus.TOOL_ROS_INTERFACE_ERROR, "Cannot ping dxl tool"
83  except rospy.ServiceException:
84  rospy.logerr("ROS Tool Interface - Failed to Ping Dynamixel Tool - "

88  def digital_output_tool_setup(self, gpio_name):
89  if rospy.get_param("/niryo_robot/hardware_version") in ['ned2', 'ned3pro']:
90  return CommandStatus.SUCCESS, "Success"
91 
92  try:
93  resp = self.__service_setup_digital_output_tool(gpio_name, SetIOModeRequest.OUTPUT) # set output
94  return resp.status, resp.message
95  except rospy.ServiceException:

97  return CommandStatus.TOOL_ROS_INTERFACE_ERROR, "Digital IO panel service failed"

99  def digital_output_tool_activate(self, gpio_name, activate):
